warnings: Legacy cache is background/zodiacal-subtracted; coverage is limited to the cached field.
Legacy FLAGS mask differs from SkyShift; no FLAGS cube is retained. All candidates remain unvetted.
Motion uses one detector and the native visit rule; parallax is not fitted.
p_false is an empirical search false-alarm estimate, not an object posterior probability.
The cold-source persistence radius is 2.5 native pixels; faster movers can be missed.

sources.gaia: Gaia DR3 (NASA/IPAC IRSA), within 3′: G ≤ 19.5 or a motion over 100 mas/yr, moved from 2016.0 to each sighting's time
sources.catwise: CatWISE2020 (NASA/IPAC IRSA), within 2.84′, moved from 2015.4 and also at its catalogue place
sources.mpc: MPC orbits of 1,580,438 asteroids at any brightness and 2,215 comets (mpcorb_2026-11-14.parquet + cometels_2026-11-14.parquet + allcometels_2026-11-16.parquet), moved with kete to each sighting's time and seen from SPHEREx; planets and moons from JPL Horizons
